scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ml -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.dev:mongo: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ml -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:mongo" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run dev:ml"
